title: Reviewer Methodology Evidence
description: Evidence states used by the reviewer methodology layer.

entries.title: Local Chunk
entries.description: The literal chunk is the primary evidence source.

entries.title: Neighboring Sentence
entries.description: The sentence before or after the chunk.

entries.title: Story Memory
entries.description: Long-range story memory used as context.

entries.title: Scene Memory
entries.description: Local scene continuity used as context.

entries.title: Speaker Cue
entries.description: A literal cue that identifies the speaker.

entries.title: Target Cue
entries.description: A literal cue that identifies the target.

entries.title: Relationship Cue
entries.description: A clue about power or relationship.

entries.title: Contradiction
entries.description: A clue that weakens the first impression.

entries.title: Exception
entries.description: An exception signal such as quotation or fiction.

entries.title: Corroboration
entries.description: Another signal that supports the reading.
